subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: If 20% of a number is 40, what is 50% of the same number?
solution: Let the number be x. 0.2x = 40, so x = 200. 50% of 200 = 100. Topic (Percentage) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
